items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, or monetization expansion. Supported revenue is limited to Amazon's 2026-09-21 aggregate result: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The 629-click tracking_id=other row cannot be assigned to a site, so site revenue and revenue claims remain unsupported. September 2026 AI usage was $950.44418695 across 5,316 calls, but it cannot be compared with one revenue day; contribution margin, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift are unknown. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation using available records; do not extrapolate or request duplicate telemetry.

Minimum evidence for a calculable finance view is a dated ledger aligned to the same period and site or content identifier, reconciling provider revenue, attributed clicks/orders/commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domain and other operating cost, plus an approved learning threshold. Until that exists: contribution margin = unknown because matching revenue and allocated costs are unavailable; cost-to-learn = unknown because no approved learning threshold and attributable outcome cost exist; budget exposure = unknown because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank; infrastructure spend = unknown because no infrastructure-cost ledger is present. Preserve these as unknown rather than zero.
